title: Settings rows with a right-aligned action
summary: A three-column grid whose last column holds buttons pushed to the right with justify-self.
explanation: Each row is three grid cells: a label, a value and an action. The third column is a fixed 120px, so every button lines up in the same column.
Buttons are only as wide as their text, so they would sit on the left of their column by default. justify-self: end moves each one to the column's right edge, without changing the column width.
tryThis: Remove justify-self from .edit: the buttons hug the left of their column.
Change the third column to 80px and watch the labels and values shift.
